easy.def: To open your mouth wide and breathe in when you are sleepy.
easy.example: I yawn when I am tired.

more.def: To open your mouth wide and take a deep breath, often when tired or bored.
more.example: The long car ride made everyone yawn.

easy.example: Yesterday we went to the park.

more.def: The day that came just before today.
more.example: Yesterday was rainy, but today the sun is out.

easy.example: A puppy is a young dog.

more.def: Having lived or existed for only a short time.
more.example: The young tree was only as tall as my knee.
